title.en: Australia should look 'very seriously' at UK-style ban on strangulation porn: minister
title.zh: 澳大利亚部长：应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国禁止勒颈色情内容

summary.en: Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography. Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a...
summary.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑进一步改革网络安全，并应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情内容中描绘勒颈的行为定为非法。她的评论是在一名16岁女孩因涉嫌性勒颈行为死亡后发表的。这起死亡事件重新引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。

body.en:
Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography.

Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act.

The death has sparked renewed concern over the rising rate of sexual violence among young people.

According to the Breathless campaign, strangulation — often referred to as "choking" — has become a common sexual practice for young Australians.

The campaign found 57 per cent of young Australians reported being strangled by a partner during sex, while 51 per cent said they had strangled a partner during sex. Among women, 61 per cent said they had experienced strangulation during sex.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Last year, the UK government moved to criminalise porn featuring strangulation or suffocating, introducing a bill that would make it illegal to create or share any such content.

It was recommended in a UK government-commissioned review of online pornography, which found that dangerous practices were being normalised, particularly for young people, through porn.

New South Wales Liberal leader Kelly Sloane has written to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to call for a similar ban in Australia.

"When pornography depicts an act capable of causing brain injury, unconsciousness or death, it should not be treated as just another form of adult entertainment," she said in a statement on Sunday.

Speaking on ABC's Insiders, Plibersek said the government should look seriously at such a ban.

"There is something wrong with a situation where 60 per cent of young people say they've experienced strangulation during sexual encounters," the federal minister said.

Plibersek said it would be crucial to educate young people that pornography is not real life.

"We know that children as young as 10 are seeing pornography before they've had their first kiss; they're getting their sex education from pornography," she said.

The government has already introduced age restrictions for social media and pornography in a bid to limit what young people view online, though concerns have been raised about loopholes .

Federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced on Sunday that the federal government would review the existing consent and respectful relationships program in schools to determine whether it needs strengthening.

Last week, three teen students were charged with the sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl in Bondi, and three boys were charged with the sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl in a...
body.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑围绕网络安全进行进一步改革，并应该“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情作品中的勒杀描述定为非法。 在她发表上述言论之前，一名 16 岁女孩最近因涉嫌性勒颈而死亡。 这起死亡事件再次引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。 据“气喘吁吁”运动称，勒颈——通常被称为“窒息”——已成为澳大利亚年轻人的常见性行为。 该活动发现，57% 的澳大利亚年轻人表示在性行为中被伴侣勒死，而 51% 的人表示他们在性行为中勒死过伴侣。在女性中，61% 的人表示她们在性行为中经历过勒颈。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 去年，英国政府将勒死或窒息的色情内容定为犯罪，并提出一项法案，规定创建或分享任何此类内容均为非法。 英国政府委托对网络色情内容进行的一项审查中建议了这一做法，该审查发现，通过色情内容，危险的做法正在正常化，尤其是对年轻人而言。 新南威尔士州自由党领袖凯利·斯隆（Kelly Sloane）已写信给总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese），呼吁在澳大利亚实施类似的禁令。 她在周日的一份声明中表示：“当色情作品描绘一种能够导致脑损伤、失去知觉或死亡的行为时，它不应被视为成人娱乐的另一种形式。” 普利伯塞克在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 的 Insiders 采访时表示，政府应该认真考虑这样的禁令。 这位联邦部长表示：“60% 的年轻人表示，他们在性接触中经历过勒颈，这种情况是有问题的。” 普利伯塞克表示，教育年轻人色情内容不是现实生活至关重要。 “我们知道，年仅 10 岁的孩子在初吻之前就会看到色情内容；他们从色情内容中接受性教育，”她说。 政府已经对社交媒体和色情内容实行了年龄限制，以限制年轻人在网上观看的内容，尽管有人担心存在漏洞。 联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔周日宣布，联邦政府将审查学校现有的同意和尊重关系计划，以确定是否需要加强。 上周，邦迪三名青少年学生被指控性侵犯一名 14 岁女孩，三名男孩被指控在邦迪性侵犯一名 17 岁女孩。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old girl and the alarming statistic that 57% of young Australians have experienced strangulation by a partner highlight the urgent need to protect the vulnerable. Minister Tanya Plibersek's consideration of a ban on strangulation pornography reflects a societal concern for the well-being of young people. Yahweh's words in...
reflection.zh: 一名16岁女孩的悲剧性死亡以及57%的澳大利亚年轻人曾被伴侣勒颈的惊人统计数据，凸显了保护弱势群体的迫切需要。社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克考虑禁止勒颈色情内容，反映了社会对年轻人福祉的关注。雅伟在马太福音18:6中的话语提醒我们，我们肩负着保护儿童的重大责任，以及那些伤害他们的人将面临的严重后果，敦使我们创造一个他们能够安全成长的环境。

verse.textEn: If anyone causes one of these little ones — those who believe in me — to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
verse.textZh: 凡使这信我的一个小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在这人的颈项上，沉在深海里。
verse.themeEn: Woe to those who harm children

body.en:
Walk down the canned fish aisle at your local supermarket right now, and there's a good chance you'll find a gap where the tinned sardines used to be, as a viral TikTok trend sends a wave of new fans in search of the small, oily fish.

The trend, dubbed "sardinemaxxing", has seen influencers push sardines as a beauty and wellness must-have, with some calling them "Botox on a fork" for their purported skin, hair, and anti-ageing benefits.

But experts say the trend raises real questions about where those sardines are coming from — and what happens if the hype spreads to other seafood.

Sardines are just the latest grocery item swept up in a social media-driven buying frenzy.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Cottage cheese and Greek yoghurt both had their moment in the past year, part of a broader "proteinmaxxing" wave prizing high-protein foods.

Lisa Asher, a retail and supermarket expert at the University of Sydney Business School, said the pattern is driven by a mix of influencer culture and wellness trends.

"What bothers me isn't that the kids are eating sardines … it's that they're taking advice now from people who are probably not people you should be listening to," Asher said.

"It's a new form of advertising with a lot of unknowns — we don't really know who's paying who and how much they're making out of it. That is a problem.

"In magazines, we used to look at celebrities, but celebrities have been replaced by influencers."

She said the trends all follow a similar pattern: demand increases, the product goes out of stock, prices sometimes rise, and eventually, when the hype cools down, it comes back in stock.

"But this is a product that is made from fish in the sea," she adds. "We don't want to overfish because suddenly, then we have none."

Adrian Meder, sustainable seafood program manager at the Australian Marine Conservation Society, says history shows a sudden cultural appetite for a particular seafood can do serious damage — pointing to shark fin soup, sea cucumber and some tuna fisheries as species pushed towards collapse by surging demand.

"We've yet to see online popularity as a driver of major declines in our oceans, but a cultural surge in popularity of a seafood has time and time again decimated populations of species from tunas, to sharks, to abalone, to sea cucumbers," Meder told SBS News.

"Online popularity is clearly capable of producing massive changes in consumer demand."

There's also a traceability problem: much of the tinned sardines on Australian shelves is imported, and it can be difficult to know where a can came from or how sustainably it was caught.

title.en: AFCD conducts control checks after dog attacks
title.zh: 渔护署在狗只袭击事件后进行管制检查

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) conducted spot checks across the city on Sunday, following recent fatal incidents involving dog attacks on people and other canines. The initiative is part of a broader push to reinforce proper dog control in public...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) conducted spot checks across the city on Sunday, following recent fatal incidents involving dog attacks on people and other canines. The initiative is part of a broader push to reinforce proper dog control in public spaces and prevent further tragedies resulting from lax supervision. At West Kowloon, AFCD officers held up placards reading "Please put your pets on leash", while distributing promotional leaflets and reminding owners to keep their dogs securely restrained. Dog owner Wong, who was at the West Kowloon waterfront, said he believes the public is largely unafraid of dogs, provided they are properly managed. As the owner of a large breed, he stressed that he always keeps his dog leashed and under strict control in public. However, he questioned the long-term effectiveness of sporadic spot checks. "Sporadic inspections like this aren't really going to fundamentally solve the problem. Most of the time, it really comes down to owners being self-disciplined," he said. Another owner echoed the sentiment, suggesting that the majority of pet owners already exercise good discipline. "If we have an aggressive dog, us owners usually already know. So in fact, most dog owners – they are quite self-disciplined, from what I see. There's no intention to deliberately make places dirty, or deliberately attack other dogs – there really isn't any of that," she said. Meanwhile the AFCD said in a social media post that it had recently seized a suspected fighting dog. It said the animal has been taken for further veterinary observation and a temperament assessment. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 继最近发生狗攻击人类和其他犬类的致命事件后，渔农自然护理署（AFCD）周日在全市进行了抽查。该举措是加强公共场所对狗的适当控制并防止监管松懈造成进一步悲剧的更广泛努力的一部分。在西九龙，渔护署人员举着“请拴住宠物”的标语牌，同时派发宣传单张，提醒业主妥善拴住狗只。西九龙海旁的狗主人黄说，他相信公众基本上不害怕狗，只要它们得到妥善管理。作为一个大型犬种的主人，他强调，他在公共场合总是用皮带拴住自己的狗并受到严格控制。不过，他对零星抽查的长期有效性提出质疑。 “像这样的零星检查并不能真正从根本上解决问题。大多数时候，这实际上取决于业主的自律，”他说。另一位主人也表达了同样的观点，认为大多数宠物主人已经遵守了良好的纪律。 “如果我们有一只具有攻击性的狗，我们的主人通常已经知道了。所以事实上，大多数狗主人——在我看来，他们都是相当自律的。他们无意故意弄脏地方，或者故意攻击其他狗——确实没有这些，”她说。与此同时，渔护署在社交媒体上发帖称，最近抓获了一只疑似斗犬。据称，这只动物已被带去接受进一步的兽医观察和性格评估。谭咏麟编辑

body.en: A 102-year-old woman, who is understood to be the mother of late singer Anita Mui, died on Sunday after she collapsed while eating. Police were alerted at about 10am by a domestic helper who said the woman had collapsed in a flat on Leighton Road in Causeway Bay. She was rushed to Ruttonjee Hospital in an unconscious state and later pronounced dead. It is understood that the woman had a history of heart disease and hypertension, and required a liquid diet and regular medication. Sources said police officers found no suspicious injuries on the woman's body, and no suspicious objects in her residence. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 一名 102 岁的老妇人，据信是已故歌手梅艳芳的母亲，于周日在吃饭时倒下身亡。上午约10时，一名家庭佣工向警方报警，称该名女子倒在铜锣湾礼顿道一间单位内。她在昏迷不醒的情况下被送往律敦治医院，其后被宣布死亡。据了解，该女子有心脏病和高血压病史，需要流质饮食和定期服药。消息人士称，警方在该女子身上没有发现可疑的伤痕，在她的住所中也没有发现可疑物品。谭咏麟编辑

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. A team of Nepal police and National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) retrieves money and documents from a bank covered in sludge in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 30, 2026. Photo: Arun Sankar/AFP. Latest figures from both countries put the number of missing at 3,044 , with a further 750 confirmed deaths — and reports of some bodies possibly swept downstream as far away as India. The disaster, which struck the China-Nepal border Wednesday morning, was caused by a glacial collapse, sending a wall of water and debris downstream, the US Geological Survey said. Chinese rescuers near the Tibet border port that was hit by a deadly mudslide were “moved to a safe location” Sunday, after a new lake was formed by a landslide, state media reported. Nepali army troops and engineers were working on Sunday to rescue workers believed trapped in a tunnel at the Trishuli 3A hydroelectric site after they successfully inserted a pipe into the passage. They have “started sending air through the small opening”, Nepali Home Minister Sudan Gurung said in a statement. Embed from Getty Images Overnight rain and rising river waters hampered efforts early Sunday, filling the excavation area with water before conditions eased and teams resumed efforts, the Nepal army said. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority listed 933 hydropower workers among the missing. China’s state news agency Xinhua reported on Sunday that experts had said “a glacier on the southern slope of Lirung Peak in Nepal” fractured, triggering an ice-rock avalanche. It said the torrent plummeted rapidly, forming a massive debris flow that travelled more than 20 kilometres before crashing into Gyirong Port. “The sudden glacial collapse and flash flood is a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be,” UN climate chief Simon Steill said in a statement. ‘Nothing left’ Survivors face an agonising wait to learn the fate of missing relatives and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away,” Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP in Nepal’s Nuwakot district. “There is nothing left.” At an army base serving as a rescue hub in Bidur, relatives crowded around lists of rescued people pasted on a wall. “I have come here looking for my son,” said Kalka Sharda,...
body.zh: 周日，一道致命的水墙和碎片席卷喜马拉雅山，吞没了整个村庄，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员在泥泞、河流上涨和新形成的湖泊的威胁下奋力搜寻数千名失踪人员。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区 Trishuli 发生山洪，尼泊尔警察和国家减少灾害风险管理局 (NDRRMA) 组成的团队从一家被污泥覆盖的银行取回资金和文件。照片：Arun Sankar/法新社。两国的最新数据显示，失踪人数为 3,044 人，另有 750 人确诊死亡，据报道，一些尸体可能被冲到下游，远至印度。美国地质调查局称，周三上午发生在中国和尼泊尔边境的这场灾难是由冰川崩塌造成的，导致水墙和碎片向下游流动。据官方媒体报道，西藏边境口岸附近遭受致命泥石流袭击的中国救援人员周日“被转移到安全地点”，山体滑坡形成了一个新的湖泊。周日，尼泊尔军队和工程师正在努力营救据信被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电站隧道中的工人，他们成功地将一根管道插入通道。尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆在一份声明中表示，他们已经“开始通过小开口输送空气”。尼泊尔军方表示，夜间降雨和不断上涨的河水阻碍了周日早些时候的工作，在情况缓解且工作人员恢复工作之前，挖掘区域已被水淹没。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔救灾当局将 933 名水电工人列为失踪人员。中国官方通讯社新华社周日报道称，专家表示，“尼泊尔利隆峰南坡的一座冰川”破裂，引发了冰岩雪崩。据称，洪流急速下降，形成巨大泥石流，行程20多公里，冲入吉隆口岸。联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯泰尔在一份声明中表示：“突然的冰川崩塌和山洪爆发毁灭性地提醒人们，这些山区环境是多么脆弱。” “一无所有”幸存者面临着痛苦的等待，他们想了解失踪亲人的命运，以及从一无所有中重建生活的前景。尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的布迪·拉姆·丹戈尔（Buddhi Ram Dangol）告诉法新社：“河流附近的所有定居点都被冲走了。” “什么都没有剩下了。”在比杜尔的一个作为救援中心的军事基地，亲属们围在墙上贴着的获救人员名单周围。 “我来这里是为了寻找我的儿子，”卡尔卡·沙达说……

title.en: China tightens rules on selling unfinished homes to lift sector
title.zh: 中国收紧销售未完工房屋的规定以提振行业

summary.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. File photo: Shuxuan Cao, via Pexels. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came to a halt when the government clamped down on excessive borrowing and rampant speculation in 2020. That left several developers grappling with massive debt — wreaking havoc on buyers who poured their savings into new homes that were never finished. Chinese officials instructed local authorities on Friday to “vigorously and orderly promote the sale of ready-to-move-in commercial housing”, while they also urged more protections for buyers who purchase homes before construction is complete. The instructions came in a joint statement from China’s National Financial Regulatory Administration, as well as Beijing’s housing and natural resource ministries. The financial regulator and China’s central bank also announced on Friday new lending guidelines that raise the maximum length for personal housing loans to 40 years, from the existing 30-year mortgage limit. “These policies are a meaningful step in the right direction,” wrote Zhiwei Zhang, President and Chief Economist at Pinpoint Asset Management. The Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. “The decision to allow mortgage loans up to 40 years helps to mitigate the home buyers’ debt burden,” he said. China’s leaders have battled sluggish domestic spending since the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, which has threatened growth even as exports and certain high-tech sectors boom. “The weak domestic demand is to a large extent due to the troubled property sector,” Zhang said, adding that the new housing policies showed officials “understand the urgency” to stabilise the market.
body.zh: 中国官员周五收紧了销售未完工房屋的规定，试图使中国房地产市场摆脱多年来拖累消费的低迷状态。资料照片：曹树轩，来自 Pexels。半建的公寓楼遍布中国各地的城市，这是房地产热潮的遗迹，随着政府在 2020 年打击过度借贷和猖獗的投机活动，房地产热潮陷入停滞。这让一些开发商陷入巨额债务的困境，这对那些将积蓄投入到从未完工的新房的买家造成了严重破坏。中国官员周五指示地方当局“大力有序促进商品房预售”，同时他们还敦促为在工程竣工前购房的购房者提供更多保护。这些指示是在中国国家金融监督管理局以及北京住建部和自然资源部的联合声明中发布的。金融监管机构和中国央行周五还宣布了新的贷款指导方针，将个人住房贷款的最长期限从现有的 30 年抵押贷款期限提高到 40 年。 “这些政策是朝着正确方向迈出的有意义的一步，”品点资产管理公司总裁兼首席经济学家张志伟写道。北京人民大会堂。照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。 “允许抵押贷款期限长达 40 年的决定有助于减轻购房者的债务负担，”他说。自Covid-19大流行结束以来，中国领导人一直在与国内支出低迷作斗争，尽管出口和某些高科技行业蓬勃发展，但国内支出仍威胁着经济增长。张说：“内需疲软在很大程度上是由于房地产行业陷入困境。”他补充说，新的住房政策表明官员“理解”稳定市场的紧迫性。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...

title.en: 'Cut-to-fuse' strategy: A new route for molecular skeletal editing
title.zh: “剪切融合”策略：分子骨架编辑的新途径

summary.en: Restructuring a molecule without rebuilding it from scratch is an increasingly important goal in modern organic chemistry. Skeletal editing is an approach that helps chemists explore new chemical structures and simplify the synthesis of molecules with potential pharmaceutical...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Restructuring a molecule without rebuilding it from scratch is an increasingly important goal in modern organic chemistry. Skeletal editing is an approach that helps chemists explore new chemical structures and simplify the synthesis of molecules with potential pharmaceutical applications.

But in the case of functional groups such as esters, skeletal editing remains difficult because their carbon–carbon and carbon–oxygen bonds are resistant to cleavage under mild conditions.

Now, a research team led by Professor Toshifumi Dohi of Ritsumeikan University, along with Yusuke Yoto, also of Ritsumeikan University, and Dr. Hideyasu China of Doshisha Women's College of Liberal Arts, developed a unique solution inspired by nature.

Their study, published in JACS Au on July 26, 2026, demonstrates that introducing chlorine into hydroxycoumarins can trigger a sequence of bond-cleavage and bond-forming events that removes a carbonyl group and reconstructs the molecule as a coumaranone.

"We aimed to develop a new way of editing molecular skeletons for esters, one that could break difficult bonds under mild conditions and immediately reconstruct the molecule into a useful framework," Dohi says.

The idea started from the team's interest in a "cut-to-fuse" strategy. In this concept, halogenation first "cuts" bonds in a cyclic compound, generating a reactive chain, before a subsequent intramolecular reaction "fuses" the chain into a new heterocyclic structure.

The researchers projected that a similar process might enable carbonyl deletion—the net removal of a carbonyl unit from hydroxycoumarins.

The initial experiments produced an unexpected result. The team had been investigating fluorine-induced carbon–carbon bond cleavage, but fluorination caused the hydroxycoumarin to fragment into separate products.

"Chlorine changed the reaction pathway completely," Dohi says. Treating a hydroxycoumarin with N -chlorosuccinimide (NCS) led to the formation of a chlorinated intermediate that underwent decarbonylative reconstruction, ultimately producing a coumaranone rather than fragmenting the molecule.

The researchers then optimized the reaction and found that the transformation could proceed at room temperature under near-neutral conditions without transition-metal catalysis. Under the optimized conditions, hydroxycoumarin was treated with NCS, water and sodium acetate in ethyl acetate, followed by potassium phosphate.

The method produced the model coumaranone in more than 99% yield. According to the researchers, this represents the mildest nonenzymatic conditions reported to date for...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 重组分子而不从头开始重建是现代有机化学中日益重要的目标。骨架编辑是一种帮助化学家探索新的化学结构并简化具有潜在药物应用的分子合成的方法。 但对于酯类等官能团来说，骨架编辑仍然很困难，因为它们的碳-碳和碳-氧键在温和条件下不易断裂。 现在，由立命馆大学的 Toshifumi Dohi 教授、立命馆大学的 Yusuke Yoto 以及同志社女子文学院的 Hideyasu China 博士领导的研究小组开发了一种受大自然启发的独特解决方案。 他们的研究于 2026 年 7 月 26 日发表在《JACS Au》上，表明将氯引入羟基香豆素中可以触发一系列键断裂和成键事件，从而去除羰基并将分子重建为香豆酮。 “我们的目标是开发一种编辑酯分子骨架的新方法，这种方法可以在温和条件下打破困难的键，并立即将分子重建成有用的框架，”多希说。 这个想法源于团队对“自断熔断”策略的兴趣。在这个概念中，卤化首先“切断”环状化合物中的键，产生反应性链，然后进行后续的分子内反应，将该链“融合”成新的杂环结构。 研究人员预计，类似的过程可能会实现羰基删除，即从羟基香豆素中净去除羰基单元。 最初的实验产生了意想不到的结果。该团队一直在研究氟引起的碳-碳键断裂，但氟化导致羟基香豆素分裂成单独的产物。 “氯完全改变了反应途径，”多希说。用 N-氯代琥珀酰亚胺 (NCS) 处理羟基香豆素，形成氯化中间体，并进行脱羰基重建，最终产生香豆酮而不是使分子断裂。 研究人员随后对反应进行了优化，发现该转化可以在室温、近中性条件下进行，无需过渡金属催化。在优化的条件下，用NCS、水和乙酸钠的乙酸乙酯溶液处理羟基香豆素，然后用磷酸钾处理。 该方法生产模型香豆酮，产率超过 99%。据研究人员称，这代表了迄今为止报道的最温和的非酶条件……

title.en: Tides can be mapped much more locally using a new method based on satellite images
title.zh: 使用基于卫星图像的新方法可以更本地化地绘制潮汐图

summary.en: When high or low tide occurs, the water does not necessarily rise and fall uniformly along the entire coastline. In fact, the height of the tide in a bay can vary by up to one meter (3 feet) from one location to another just a few kilometers away.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When high or low tide occurs, the water does not necessarily rise and fall uniformly along the entire coastline. In fact, the height of the tide in a bay can vary by up to one meter (3 feet) from one location to another just a few kilometers away.

This is shown in a new study published by researchers from DTU Space in collaboration with colleagues from the University of Oxford and the Technical University of Munich (TUM), as well as the German space technology company OHB. Together, they have analyzed satellite images taken over a period of more than 40 years by the U.S. Landsat program.

Typically, tides are measured using water level gauges located at specific sites or through satellite measurements of the sea surface. Especially in sparsely populated areas, this leaves large areas without direct measurements of tidal height along the coast.

"Typically, water level gauges are spaced 50 km (31 miles) apart or more, and measurements are then calculated from their values. With this method, we can instead use satellite images of the coastline to obtain a much more detailed picture of how tidal levels vary geographically along a given coastline," says Professor Ole Baltazar Andersen of DTU Space, a co-author of the study, which has been published in Communications Earth & Environment .

By tracking the boundary between land and water across thousands of satellite images and combining these data with information about the beach's slope, researchers can calculate changes in water level and thus tidal variations.

"Variations in the coastline have often been regarded as noise that needed to be removed from satellite data. Here, we show that this noise can instead be used as a signal to map tidal patterns on a very local scale," he says.

The extensive satellite data allow researchers to verify and improve existing tidal models, thereby contributing in the long term to more accurate local forecasts of high and low tides.

"The interesting thing is that we can use this new knowledge to improve the models. In the long run, this could give us better local tidal forecasts, even along coastal stretches where we currently have very few measurements," says Andersen.

This could be particularly significant in areas where traditional water level gauges are few and far between.

"In Denmark, we have many water level gauges and relatively small tidal variations, so here the method isn't quite as significant. But in Greenland, for example, it's completely different. There are only a handful of physical water level gauges, while the daily variation in the tides can be as much as five to...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当涨潮或退潮发生时，水位不一定沿着整个海岸线均匀地涨落。事实上，海湾中的潮汐高度从一个地点到几公里外的另一个地点可能会相差一米（3 英尺）。 DTU Space 的研究人员与牛津大学、慕尼黑工业大学 (TUM) 以及德国空间技术公司 OHB 的同事合作发表的一项新研究表明了这一点。他们共同分析了美国陆地卫星计划 40 多年来拍摄的卫星图像。 通常，潮汐是使用位于特定地点的水位计或通过卫星测量海面来测量的。特别是在人口稀少的地区，这使得沿海大片地区无法直接测量潮汐高度。 “通常，水位计的间距为 50 公里（31 英里）或更远，然后根据其值计算测量结果。通过这种方法，我们可以使用海岸线的卫星图像来更详细地了解潮汐水位如何沿着给定的海岸线在地理上变化，”该研究的合著者、DTU Space 的 Ole Baltazar Andersen 教授说道，该研究已发表在《通信地球与环境》杂志上。 通过跟踪数千张卫星图像中陆地和水域之间的边界，并将这些数据与海滩坡度信息相结合，研究人员可以计算出水位的变化，从而计算出潮汐的变化。 “海岸线的变化通常被认为是需要从卫星数据中消除的噪音。在这里，我们表明这种噪音可以用作信号，在非常局部的范围内绘制潮汐模式，”他说。 广泛的卫星数据使研究人员能够验证和改进现有的潮汐模型，从而从长远来看有助于更准确地预测当地的高潮和低潮。 “有趣的是，我们可以利用这些新知识来改进模型。从长远来看，这可以为我们提供更好的当地潮汐预报，即使是在我们目前测量很少的沿海地区，”安德森说。 这在传统水位计很少且相隔很远的地区尤其重要。 “在丹麦，我们有很多水位计和相对较小的潮汐变化，所以这里的方法并不那么重要。但在格陵兰岛，情况就完全不同了。只有少数物理水位计，而潮汐的每日变化可能高达五到......

title.en: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
title.zh: “巨大的飞跃”：美国宇航局发射强大的新型太空望远镜

summary.en: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Nasa's powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.

The Nancy Grace Roman telescope will capture vast panoramic views of space, with a field of vision 100 times larger than both the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes, Nasa says.

The mission begins with a 100-day journey to a vantage point roughly one million miles from Earth, where the telescope will then start charting planets outside our solar system, known as exoplanets.

"Roman is going to change the way we look at the Universe," said Nicky Fox, a Nasa administrator.

The successful launch of the telescope took place on Sunday morning local time from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Jackie Townsend, a project manager on Nasa's Roman telescope, described it as "glorious" at a news conference afterwards. "The ride was magnificent. It put us right where we wanted to be."

About 30 minutes after launch, Roman separated from its SpaceX rocket and is now heading towards its orbiting point around a million miles away.

Fox said Roman "is going to discover tens of thousands, maybe even 100,000 new exoplanets" - referring to planets located outside of our solar system.

"Why do we care so much about exoplanets? Because one of our main goals at Nasa is answering the question, 'Are we alone in the universe'?" she added.

US President Donald Trump dialled in to the space agency's news conference to congratulate the scientists working on the project.

"You're the hottest in space, and we have the hottest country anywhere in the world. So, let's keep it all going. You're a big part of it," Trump said.

Astronomer Jenifer Millard said the telescope will be four times further from Earth than the Moon is, where a lot of infrared space cameras - made to pick up what she describes as "heat light"- operate.

She told the BBC this is to make sure infrared light from the Moon and Earth don't interfere with the cameras.

Nasa's James Webb Space Telescope, launched in 2021, also orbits the Sun around one million miles from Earth, but its field of vision is not as expansive. Nasa's Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, orbits at about 300 miles above Earth's surface.

While Roman will look outward into the Universe, Millard said scientists are also anticipating it will find thousands of new worlds in our own galaxy.

The telescope is named after physicist Nancy Grace Roman, who was Nasa's first chief astronomer in the 1960s and its first female executive.

During her career, she was instrumental in getting the Hubble Space Telescope approved by US Congress and later said its most interesting discovery was dark energy.

title.en: As super El Nino strengthens, study suggests that climate change is intensifying El Ninos
title.zh: 随着超级厄尔尼诺现象加强，研究表明气候变化正在加剧厄尔尼诺现象

summary.en: A new study suggests that El Ninos—the natural climatic chaos agent that pops up periodically and spikes global temperatures—are getting stronger because of human-caused climate change.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new study suggests that El Ninos—the natural climatic chaos agent that pops up periodically and spikes global temperatures—are getting stronger because of human-caused climate change.

El Ninos are more than 36% stronger than they were before the industrial age began in the mid 1800s, with a 16% jump in just the last 40 years showing that the increase is accelerating, according to a study in Thursday's journal Science . The findings come as a strong El Niño that formed a couple months ago is forecast to be the biggest on record in coming months. El Ninos, which are a temporary warming of parts of the equatorial Pacific, warp weather worldwide and increase extreme events, including heat waves, floods in some places and droughts in others. They can cost trillions in damage.

"That's important because strong El Ninos have much stronger impacts on climate hazards and extremes worldwide. When we set out to answer the question of why this might be happening, we set our data up against a record of global temperature, and we found that the increase in El Niño's strength closely parallels the rise in global temperature that is due to human causes such as the burning of fossil fuels," said study lead author Julia Cole, a paleoclimate scientist at the University of Michigan.

"El Niño is the most violent aspect of climate variability worldwide, with effects ranging from local fisheries collapse, to widespread coral die-offs to severe droughts and food shortages around the world," said Dalhousie University marine scientist Boris Worm, who wasn't part of the study.

Worm quoted the late climate scientist Wallace Broecker who warned "the climate system is an angry beast and we are poking it with sticks." And then Worm added, "Human emissions are the stick and El Niño is of the 'angry' outbursts that can be so threatening to our collective safety."

An El Niño's strength is determined by measuring water temperature in a region of the central Pacific around the equator and comparing a three-month average to normal. If it's 0.5 degrees Celsius (0.9 degrees Fahrenheit) warmer than normal, it's becomes an El Niño. The top of the scale is 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 degrees Fahrenheit) and is called "very strong." The most recent weekly El Niño figure is at 2.7 degrees (4.9 degrees Fahrenheit) and is expected to keep growing for another two to four months, according to Columbia University's El Niño tracker.

Scientists have long theorized that as the world warms, El Ninos would get stronger because they are based on ocean temperature differences compared to average. But observational records...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一项新的研究表明，厄尔尼诺现象——周期性出现并导致全球气温飙升的自然气候混乱因素——由于人为造成的气候变化而变得越来越强。 根据周四《科学》杂志上的一项研究，厄尔尼诺现象比 1800 年代中期工业时代开始之前强了 36% 以上，在过去 40 年里猛增了 16%，表明厄尔尼诺现象正在加速。这一发现发布之际，几个月前形成的强烈厄尔尼诺现象预计将在未来几个月成为有记录以来最严重的厄尔尼诺现象。厄尔尼诺现象是赤道太平洋部分地区暂时变暖的现象，它会扭曲全世界的天气，并增加极端事件的发生，包括热浪、某些地方的洪水和其他地方的干旱。它们可能造成数万亿美元的损失。 “这一点很重要，因为强烈的厄尔尼诺现象对全球气候危害和极端事件的影响要大得多。当我们着手回答为什么会发生这种情况的问题时，我们根据全球气温记录设置了数据，我们发现厄尔尼诺现象强度的增加与由于人类原因（例如燃烧化石燃料）导致的全球气温上升密切相关，”该研究的主要作者、密歇根大学古气候科学家朱莉娅·科尔（Julia Cole）说。 达尔豪斯大学海洋科学家鲍里斯·沃姆（Boris Worm）没有参与这项研究，他说：“厄尔尼诺现象是全球气候变化最剧烈的现象，其影响范围包括当地渔业崩溃、珊瑚大面积死亡、全球严重干旱和粮食短缺。” 沃姆援引已故气候科学家华莱士·布罗克的话说，“气候系统是一头愤怒的野兽，我们正在用棍棒戳它。”然后沃尔姆补充道，“人类排放是大棒，而厄尔尼诺现象是‘愤怒’的爆发，可能对我们的集体安全构成如此大的威胁。” 厄尔尼诺现象的强度是通过测量赤道周围太平洋中部地区的水温并将三个月平均值与正常水平进行比较来确定的。如果气温比正常情况高 0.5 摄氏度（0.9 华氏度），就会形成厄尔尼诺现象。最高温度为 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），称为“非常强”。根据哥伦比亚大学的厄尔尼诺现象追踪器，最近的每周厄尔尼诺现象为 2.7 度（4.9 华氏度），预计将在接下来的两到四个月内继续增长。 科学家们长期以来一直认为，随着世界变暖，厄尔尼诺现象会变得更强，因为它们是基于海洋温度与平均温度的差异而产生的。但观察记录...

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The intestines rely on different strategies to rebuild themselves in response to diet changes versus infections, according to a new Cornell study—a finding that can shed light on how gut health adapts to harsh conditions, flourishing ecosystems of microbes and variable diets.

The findings , reported in Communications Biology , show that infectious damage causes cell loss and triggers stem cells to create new ones, while diet changes cause existing cells to grow or shrink.

"We want to understand the basic mechanisms of how stem cells respond to microbes and repair the gut because these findings will, we hope, ultimately help us address infections and diseases like Crohn's and cancer," said Nicolas Buchon, senior author of the paper and associate professor of entomology in the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences. "We may want to boost stem cell response to help with repair after a serious infection. Or we may want to limit stem cell proliferation if cells are responding aberrantly and building a tumor."

Pharmaceuticals or therapeutics based on these findings are many years away, but basic discoveries like this one lay the foundation for future breakthroughs.

In 2009, Buchon and colleagues reported that when fruit flies were infected with the bacterium Erwinia carotovora (Ecc15), the microbes triggered an immune response and stem cell proliferation . The finding helped establish how microbes can connect an immune response to stem-cell-driven repair in the intestine.

The current study also relies on fruit flies and Ecc15, but explores the interplay of infection and nutritional status at the same time. Scientists studying the gut generally examine one factor or the other, and that division has led to very different assumptions about how the intestines adapt and rebuild, Buchon said.

"If you study the gut from the perspective of nutrition, you can conclude that the gut is constantly shifting and adapting: Feed less, and the gut will shrink; eat more nutritious food, and it will expand," he said. "If you look at microbes and infection, the key word is always homeostasis. That means if you damage the gut, it will rebuild to its former state. So our question was, well, which one is it? Can we manipulate food, manipulate microbes and play with the complete matrix to see how the gut responds to all of those stimuli at once?"

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 康奈尔大学的一项新研究表明，肠道依靠不同的策略进行自我重建，以应对饮食变化和感染，这一发现可以揭示肠道健康如何适应恶劣的条件、繁荣的微生物生态系统和多样化的饮食。 发表在《通讯生物学》上的研究结果表明，感染性损伤会导致细胞损失并触发干细胞产生新细胞，而饮食变化会导致现有细胞生长或缩小。 该论文的资深作者、农业与生命科学学院昆虫学副教授 Nicolas Buchon 表示：“我们希望了解干细胞如何响应微生物并修复肠道的基本机制，因为我们希望这些发现最终能够帮助我们解决感染和克罗恩病以及癌症等疾病。” “我们可能希望增强干细胞反应，以帮助严重感染后的修复。或者，如果细胞反应异常并形成肿瘤，我们可能希望限制干细胞增殖。” 基于这些发现的药物或疗法还需要很多年的时间，但像这样的基本发现为未来的突破奠定了基础。 2009年，Buchon及其同事报告说，当果蝇感染胡萝卜软腐欧文氏菌（Ecc15）时，这些微生物会引发免疫反应和干细胞增殖。这一发现有助于确定微生物如何将免疫反应与肠道干细胞驱动的修复联系起来。 目前的研究还依赖于果蝇和 Ecc15，但同时探讨了感染和营养状况之间的相互作用。布雄说，研究肠道的科学家通常会检查一个因素或另一个因素，这种划分导致了关于肠道如何适应和重建的非常不同的假设。 “如果你从营养的角度研究肠道，你可以得出结论，肠道在不断地变化和适应：吃得少，肠道就会缩小；吃更多有营养的食物，它就会扩张，”他说。 “如果你研究微生物和感染，关键词总是稳态。这意味着如果你损伤肠道，它会重建到以前的状态。所以我们的问题是，到底是哪一种？我们能否操纵食物、操纵微生物并利用完整的矩阵来观察肠道如何同时对所有这些刺激做出反应？” 在果蝇实验中，科学家们经常使用果蝇来进行基础生物学的发现，这些发现适用于包括人类在内的所有多细胞生物体，他们发现肠道感染的后果......

title.en: 1.4-million-year-old footprints reveal a surprisingly large human relative
title.zh: 140 万年前的脚印揭示了一个体型惊人的人类近亲

summary.en: Ancient footprints in Kenya reveal that eight Paranthropus boisei may have traveled together 1.4 million years ago, with some individuals reaching surprisingly large, human-like body sizes. The tracks offer a rare glimpse of their social behavior and suggest these extinct human...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A remarkable set of fossil footprints from northern Kenya is offering scientists a rare glimpse of how an extinct human relative may have moved and interacted about 1.4 million years ago.

The tracks, preserved near an ancient lakeshore, appear to record eight Paranthropus boisei individuals occupying the same place at roughly the same time. Researchers describe the discovery as a snapshot of "fossil behavior" because, unlike bones that can accumulate over long periods, footprints can capture a brief moment in the lives of individuals.

The international team, made up of researchers from the US and Kenya, concluded that all eight trackmakers were likely adults. Several also appear to have been considerably larger than earlier estimates of Paranthropus boisei body size based on the limited skeletal remains available.

The researchers used analytical techniques first developed by their team in 2024 to identify the footprints as belonging to Paranthropus boisei . The classification was based on clues in foot anatomy as well as the way the individuals appear to have moved.

"The sizes of the footprints indicate human-like body sizes - up to 1.8 meters tall and around 75 kilograms," says lead author Kevin Hatala, of Chatham University and an associated researcher of the Department of Human Origins at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Leipzig.

For decades, most known fossils of Paranthropus boisei consisted of skulls, including specimens with exceptionally large jaws and teeth. Much less has been known about what the species looked like below the neck because fossils from the rest of the skeleton are far rarer.

The new tracks now challenge earlier research suggesting that Paranthropus boisei was substantially smaller than Homo erectus , another hominin that lived during the same general period and is considered a possible direct ancestor of modern humans.

Footprints can reveal more than anatomy. Because a walking surface may be formed and preserved over a very short span of time, fossil tracks can provide direct evidence about movement, group size, and possible social interactions.

In this case, the eight individuals appear to have been traveling together. Most were likely adult males, with no obvious evidence of females or children among them.

"The fact that eight, mostly adult male, Paranthropus boisei individuals seemingly traveled together as a group, without females or children, hints at a complex social structure in this species," says co-author Neil Roach of Harvard University. "They may have lived in large groups, where males competed for mates, but also tolerated each other at times for safety in a dangerous environment."

That possibility adds a new dimension to what scientists know about Paranthropus boisei . The...
body.zh: 肯尼亚北部发现的一组引人注目的化石足迹让科学家们得以难得一睹已灭绝的人类亲戚在大约 140 万年前是如何移动和互动的。 这些足迹保存在一个古老的湖岸附近，似乎记录了八个博氏傍人个体在大约同一时间占据同一地点。研究人员将这一发现描述为“化石行为”的快照，因为与可以长期积累的骨头不同，脚印可以捕捉个人生活中的短暂瞬间。 由来自美国和肯尼亚的研究人员组成的国际小组得出的结论是，所有八名田径运动员都可能是成年人。其中一些似乎比先前根据有限的骨骼遗骸估计的博伊西傍人的体型要大得多。 研究人员使用他们的团队于 2024 年首次开发的分析技术来识别这些脚印是否属于博伊人傍人 (Paranthropus boisei)。该分类是基于足部解剖学的线索以及个体的移动方式。 查塔姆大学的主要作者、莱比锡马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所人类起源系的研究员凯文·哈塔拉（Kevin Hatala）说：“脚印的大小表明了类似人类的身体尺寸——高1.8米，重约75公斤。” 几十年来，大多数已知的博氏拟人化石都是由头骨组成，其中包括具有异常大的下巴和牙齿的标本。人们对这个物种脖子以下的样子知之甚少，因为骨骼其余部分的化石要少得多。 这些新足迹现在挑战了早期的研究，即博伊人傍人比直立人小得多，直立人是生活在同一时期的另一种古人类，被认为可能是现代人类的直接祖先。 足迹不仅仅能揭示解剖结构。由于行走表面可能在很短的时间内形成并保存，因此化石足迹可以提供有关运动、群体规模和可能的社会互动的直接证据。 在这种情况下，这八个人似乎是一起旅行的。大多数可能是成年男性，没有明显证据表明其中有女性或儿童。 哈佛大学的合著者尼尔·罗奇（Neil Roach）表示：“八个博氏傍人（其中大多数是成年雄性）似乎作为一个群体一起旅行，没有雌性或儿童，这一事实暗示了该物种复杂的社会结构。” “它们可能生活在大群体中，雄性争夺配偶，但有时也会在危险的环境中为了安全而互相容忍。” 这种可能性为科学家们对博氏傍人的了解增加了一个新的维度。这...

title.en: This strange “spacetime crystal” can suddenly become a black hole
title.zh: 这种奇怪的“时空晶体”可以突然变成黑洞

summary.en: Physicists have mathematically captured a bizarre “spacetime crystal” that can either dissolve or collapse into a microscopic black hole after only a tiny change in energy. Their breakthrough came from an unusual trick involving infinitely many dimensions, potentially giving...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Physics allows for black holes far smaller than the enormous objects typically found at the centers of galaxies or created when massive stars collapse. Under the right conditions, microscopic black holes could also form when spacetime enters an unusual critical state and organizes into a repeating, crystal-like pattern.

Researchers from Goethe University Frankfurt and TU Wien have now found a way to describe this process mathematically. For the first time, they derived an exact formula for the phenomenon by using an unconventional mathematical approach.

Most familiar black holes are associated with violent cosmic events, including the deaths of massive stars. In theory, however, there is no strict lower size limit. Extremely small black holes could arise from special critical states in which even a tiny addition of energy can determine whether the system disperses or collapses.

Conditions like these may have existed in the early universe, shortly after the Big Bang, when matter and energy were packed into an intensely chaotic environment. Such circumstances could potentially have produced primordial black holes.

Computer simulations had already shown that these unusual critical structures should be possible. The challenge was finding a mathematical description that could reproduce what the simulations revealed. Researchers at Goethe University Frankfurt and TU Wien have now done that with a formula that can be worked out analytically, using what the scientists describe as essentially paper and pencil.

"Sometimes a tiny, seemingly insignificant cause is enough to trigger a huge and dramatic change," says Prof. Daniel Grumiller from TU Wien. "Take liquid water at zero degrees Celsius, for example. A very small change is enough to make the water freeze. The water molecules then spontaneously arrange themselves into a regular pattern and form an ice crystal."

Einstein's theory of relativity suggests that spacetime can undergo something conceptually similar. Matter influences the geometry of spacetime, and changes in the distribution of particles can therefore alter its curvature.

"We say that spacetime is curved by mass," explains Christian Ecker from the Institute for Theoretical Physics at Goethe University Frankfurt. "Large objects such as stars curve spacetime strongly -- for example, we can observe this when light rays are deflected by massive stars. But smaller masses also produce spacetime curvature, just to a lesser extent."

Under critical conditions, that curvature can arrange itself into a repeating pattern across space and time. The researchers describe the resulting structure as a kind of "spacetime crystal." The process that produces this finely balanced state is known as critical collapse.

title.en: HEPA air purifiers may boost brain function after just one month
title.zh: HEPA 空气净化器仅一个月后即可增强大脑功能

summary.en: Adults aged 40 and older performed about 12% faster on a test of executive function after using a HEPA air purifier at home for one month. The findings suggest that cleaner indoor air could offer a simple way to help protect the brain from the effects of traffic-related...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Using an in-home HEPA purifier for one month spurs a small but significant improvement in brain function in adults age 40 and older. That’s the result of a new study we co-authored in the journal Scientific Reports .

HEPA purifiers – HEPA stands for high efficiency particulate air – remove particulate matter from the air . Exposure to particulate matter has been connected to respiratory and cardiovascular illnesses as well as neurological diseases such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s . Environmental health researchers increasingly recommend that people use HEPA air purifiers in their homes to lower their exposure to particulate matter , but few studies have examined whether using them boosts mental function.

We analyzed data from a study of 119 people ages 30 to 74 living in Somerville, Massachusetts. Somerville sits along Interstate 93 and Route 28, two major highways, resulting in relatively high levels of traffic-related air pollution . This makes it an especially good location for testing the health effects of air purifiers.

We randomly assigned participants to one of two groups. One used a HEPA air purifier for one month and then a sham air purifier – which looked and acted like the real thing but did not contain the air-cleaning filter – for one month, with a monthlong break in between. The second group used the real and sham purifiers in reverse order.

After each month, participants took a test that measured different aspects of their mental capacity . The test probed people’s visual memory and motor speed skills by measuring how quickly they could draw lines between sequential numbers, and it tested executive function and mental flexibility by asking them to draw lines between alternating sequential numbers and letters.

We found that participants 40 years and older – about 42% of our sample – on average completed the section testing for mental flexibility and executive function 12% faster after using the HEPA purifier than after using the sham purifier. That was true even when we accounted for factors like differences in the amount of time participants spent indoors, with either filter, as well as how stressful they found the test.

This improvement may seem small, but it is similar to the cognitive benefits that people experience from increasing their daily exercise . While you may not experience a sudden increase in clarity from a 12% boost, preventing cognitive decline is vital for long-term well-being. Even small decreases in cognitive functioning may be associated with a higher risk of death .

body.zh: 使用家用 HEPA 净化器一个月可以使 40 岁及以上成年人的大脑功能得到小幅但显着的改善。这是我们在《科学报告》杂志上共同撰写的一项新研究的结果。 HEPA 净化器 – HEPA 代表高效颗粒空气 – 去除空气中的颗粒物质。接触颗粒物与呼吸系统和心血管疾病以及阿尔茨海默氏症和帕金森氏症等神经系统疾病有关。环境健康研究人员越来越多地建议人们在家中使用 HEPA 空气净化器来减少接触颗粒物的机会，但很少有研究探讨使用它们是否可以增强心理功能。 我们分析了一项针对居住在马萨诸塞州萨默维尔的 119 名年龄在 30 岁至 74 岁之间的人的研究数据。萨默维尔位于 93 号州际公路和 28 号公路这两条主要高速公路沿线，导致与交通相关的空气污染水平相对较高。这使得它成为测试空气净化器对健康影响的特别好的场所。 我们将参与者随机分配到两组中的一组。其中一个人使用了 HEPA 空气净化器一个月，然后又使用了假空气净化器（外观和功能都与真品一样，但没有空气净化过滤器）一个月，中间休息了一个月。第二组以相反的顺序使用真实和假净化器。 每个月后，参与者都会进行一项测试，测量他们心理能力的不同方面。该测试通过测量人们在连续数字之间画线的速度来探究人们的视觉记忆和运动速度技能，并通过要求他们在交替的连续数字和字母之间画线来测试执行功能和心理灵活性。 我们发现，40 岁及以上的参与者（约占样本的 42%）在使用 HEPA 净化器后完成心理灵活性和执行功能部分测试的速度比使用假净化器后平均快 12%。即使我们考虑了参与者在室内使用任一过滤器的时间差异以及他们在测试中感受到的压力等因素，情况也是如此。 这种改善可能看起来很小，但它类似于人们通过增加日常锻炼而体验到的认知益处。虽然您可能不会体验到 12% 的清晰度突然提高，但防止认知能力下降对于长期健康至关重要。即使认知功能的小幅下降也可能与更高的死亡风险相关。 接触空气污染几个小时后就会对精神功能产生负面影响。研究表明空气净化器可以有效减少颗粒物，但它......

summary.zh: 价值43亿美元的南希·格蕾丝·罗马人太空望远镜将于周日早晨从佛罗里达州发射升空，该望远镜旨在寻找系外行星并探索行星形成的线索。它曾两次躲过白宫的预算削减提议，并将从肯尼迪航天中心启程，开始一段长达一百万英里的深空之旅，但发射日期仍可能受限于技术问题或佛罗里达州夏季多变的天气。

body.en: Searching for exoplanets and clues on planet formation, the Roman telescope begins million-mile journey from Florida launchpad A $4.3bn space telescope that Donald Trump tried to kill has lifted off from Florida as Nasa embarks on the next stage of its quest to unlock the secrets of the universe. The Nancy Grace Roman space telescope survived two rounds of proposed White House budget cuts, and began a million-mile journey into deep space from a launchpad at the Kennedy Space Center on Sunday morning. . Continue reading...
body.zh: 为了寻找系外行星和行星形成的线索，罗马望远镜将于周日早上在佛罗里达州升空。唐纳德·特朗普试图摧毁的这台价值 43 亿美元的太空望远镜将于周日早些时候从佛罗里达州升空，美国宇航局将开始下一阶段的探索，以解开宇宙的秘密。南希·格蕾丝·罗曼太空望远镜在白宫提出的两轮预算削减中幸存下来，并将于美国东部时间上午 7 点 26 分从肯尼迪航天中心的发射台开始一百万英里的深空之旅，除非出现后期技术问题或受到佛罗里达州臭名昭著的反复无常的夏季天气的干扰。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The launch of the Nancy Grace Roman space telescope represents humanity's enduring curiosity about the cosmos. As this powerful instrument begins its journey, it serves as a reminder that the vastness of space and the intricate workings of planet formation are a testament to a Creator's design. The heavens indeed declare the glory of Yahweh, inviting us to...
reflection.zh: 南希·格蕾丝·罗马人太空望远镜的发射，代表了人类对宇宙永恒的好奇心。当这个强大的仪器开始它的旅程时，它提醒我们，宇宙的浩瀚和行星形成的复杂运作，都是造物主设计的证明。诸天确实述说着雅伟的荣耀，邀请我们惊叹于祂所创造的宇宙，并怀有敬畏之心。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Researchers find Britain’s 11th-century ‘Conquest Man’ was Scandinavian – but did he land with the Norman army?
title.zh: 研究发现英国11世纪的“征服者”是斯堪的纳维亚人——但他是否随诺曼军队登陆？

summary.en: Genetic analysis reveals that an 11th-century individual found in Humberside, Britain, was of Scandinavian origin. While it's plausible he arrived during the Norman Conquest era, researchers suggest it's more likely he was part of the broader migration to the Viking-controlled Danelaw, rather than directly involved...
summary.zh: 基因分析显示，在英国亨伯赛德郡发现的一位11世纪的个体来自斯堪的纳维亚。虽然他有可能是在诺曼征服时期抵达的，但研究人员认为，他更可能是作为大批移民中的一员来到维京人控制的丹麦区，而不是直接参与黑斯廷斯战役的诺曼军队。

body.en: It’s ‘plausible’, though more likely the Humberside resident was one of many immigrants to Viking-controlled Danelaw One of the most consequential showdowns in the history of the British Isles, the Battle of Hastings is seen as the foundational event of the Anglo-Saxons’ conquest by their Norman enemy across the Channel. But researchers who have put flesh on the bones of one man who lived through the turmoil of the era are learning more about the fighters who may have belonged to neither side. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这是“合理的”，尽管亨伯赛德居民更有可能是维京人控制的丹麦法的众多移民之一。黑斯廷斯战役是不列颠群岛历史上最重要的对决之一，被视为盎格鲁撒克逊人跨过英吉利海峡被诺曼敌人征服的基础事件。但研究人员对一位经历过那个时代动乱的人的骨头进行了研究，他们正在更多地了解那些可能不属于任何一方的战士。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery about 'Conquest Man' reminds us that history is rarely simple, often a complex tapestry of migrations, conflicts, and identities. Even in eras of upheaval like the Norman Conquest, individuals were part of larger, ongoing movements. This complexity mirrors the human struggle to overcome cycles of animosity, urging us to choose good over evil,...
reflection.zh: 关于“征服者”的发现提醒我们，历史很少是简单的，它常常是迁徙、冲突和身份认同交织的复杂织锦。即使在诺曼征服这样的动荡时期，个体也属于更大、持续的群体运动的一部分。这种复杂性反映了人类克服敌意循环的挣扎，敦促我们在冲突界限模糊时，也要选择以善胜恶。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Charity thanks inmates for work to save hedgehogs
title.zh: 慈善机构感谢囚犯拯救刺猬的工作

summary.en: Prisoners at HMP La Moye are constructing feeding and nesting boxes for the Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group using reclaimed timber. This initiative is praised for teaching inmates valuable carpentry skills, potentially reducing reoffending rates by equipping them for future employment and fostering a sense of...
summary.zh: 位于拉莫耶监狱（HMP La Moye）的囚犯正在利用回收的木材为泽西刺猬保护协会制作喂食箱和筑巢箱。这项倡议因教授囚犯宝贵的木工技能而受到赞扬，有可能通过为他们未来的就业做准备并培养社区贡献感来降低再犯率。

body.en:
An animal charity has thanked prison inmates for helping to save hedgehogs' lives.

Prisoners in HMP La Moye, in St Brelade, have given Jersey Hedgehog Preservation Group 20 feeding and nesting boxes which they have made out of reclaimed pallet timber.

Peter Gould, the prison's vocational manager, said the work could help reduce reoffending because it taught inmates skills to support future employment and helped them feel they were contributing to the community.

Dru Burdon, from the hedgehog group, said: "If it helps with carpentry skills training, so much the better, these boxes are certainly saving hedgehogs' lives."

Gould said the project also taught health and safety best practice and gave prisoners experience of using machinery and equipment.

"For some, the project provides a valuable introduction to skills that could lead to recognised qualifications and careers in the construction industry."

He said the project helped inmates have a "sense of purpose, achievement and connection to the community" which was "incredibly valuable".

Burdon said the scheme had developed from a chance meeting with a prison officer at the vets.

She said: "He found a little hedgehog in need of care and we got talking, so the upshot was that I gave them the templates for both nesting and feeding boxes."

She said of the 20 boxes the prisoners had given the charity earlier in August, all the feeding boxes had sold out and raised £20 each and there were just a few £25 nesting boxes left.

Gould said the hedgehog boxes formed part of a wider programme of vocational projects at the prison.

These included refurbishing bikes for donations to the Age Concern Jersey charity, restoring memorial benches , growing plants and vegetables for the prison kitchen and for charity, and helping create wildlife habitats.

"We're proud of the positive contribution prisoners can make through this work and pleased to see these projects being recognised," he added.

body.zh: 一家动物慈善机构感谢监狱囚犯帮助拯救刺猬的生命。 圣布雷拉德 HMP La Moye 的囚犯向泽西刺猬保护小组提供了 20 个用回收托盘木材制成的喂养箱和筑巢箱。 监狱职业经理彼得·古尔德表示，这项工作有助于减少再次犯罪，因为它教会了囚犯未来就业的技能，并帮助他们感觉自己正在为社区做出贡献。 刺猬小组的德鲁·伯登说：“如果这有助于木工技能培训，那就更好了，这些盒子肯定能拯救刺猬的生命。” 古尔德说，该项目还教授健康和安全最佳实践，并为囚犯提供使用机械和设备的经验。 “对于一些人来说，该项目提供了宝贵的技能介绍，可以帮助他们获得建筑行业认可的资格和职业。” 他说，该项目帮助囚犯产生“使命感、成就感以及与社区的联系”，这是“非常有价值的”。 伯登说，这个计划是在一次与兽医监狱官员的偶然会面中制定的。 她说：“他发现一只需要照顾的小刺猬，我们进行了交谈，所以结果是我给了他们筑巢和饲养箱的模板。” 她说，囚犯们在八月初向慈善机构捐赠了 20 个盒子，其中所有喂食盒都已售罄，每个盒子筹集了 20 英镑，只剩下几个 25 英镑的巢箱。 古尔德说，刺猬盒子是监狱更广泛的职业项目计划的一部分。 其中包括翻新自行车以向 Age Concern Jersey 慈善机构捐款、修复纪念长凳、为监狱厨房和慈善机构种植植物和蔬菜，以及帮助创建野生动物栖息地。 他补充说：“我们为囚犯通过这项工作做出的积极贡献感到自豪，并很高兴看到这些项目得到认可。” 在 X（外部）和 Facebook（外部）上关注 BBC Jersey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: In a remarkable act of rehabilitation and conservation, prisoners at HMP La Moye are channeling their efforts into crafting essential nesting and feeding boxes for hedgehogs. This project not only aids a vulnerable species but also equips the inmates with practical skills, offering them a pathway toward future employment and a renewed sense of purpose...
reflection.zh: 在感化和保育方面的一项了不起的举措中，拉莫耶监狱的囚犯正致力于为刺猬制作重要的筑巢箱和喂食箱。这个项目不仅帮助了一个脆弱的物种，也为囚犯提供了实用的技能，为他们未来的就业铺平了道路，并培养了他们对社区的价值感和新的目标感。这是一个有力的提醒，即使在充满挑战的环境中，有意义的工作也能促进治愈和希望。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Nature reserves spot rare species during heatwaves
title.zh: 自然保护区在热浪期间发现稀有物种

summary.en: A wildlife trust says unusually hot weather and increased monitoring has led to interesting finds.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A wildlife trust said some species had been spotted in nature reserves this summer for the first time in years.

Volunteers for the Herts and Middlesex Wildlife Trust recorded a great white egret near Ware and more than 300 Chalkhill blue butterflies at Hexton Chalk Pit near Hitchin, where they also found a glow-worm for the first time in 25 years.

The trust said it was partly due to the unusually hot weather but also the result of increased surveying and monitoring in the county.

Senior reserves officer Dan Townsend said: "This summer we've had some extraordinary records, from species that haven't been recorded in Hertfordshire for decades to new discoveries for individual reserves."

The St Albans-based trust manages more than 40 nature reserves covering nearly 810 hectares (2,000 acres) in Hertfordshire and Middlesex.

It said grasshoppers had flourished during the hot summer, while butterflies had been able to complete their life cycle more quickly and emerge in large numbers.

Its reserves have provided the setting for several significant discoveries by the Herts Invertebrate Project , external , which was set up in 2015.

At the end of June, the project visited Fir & Pond Woods, near Potters Bar, and recorded Euides basilinea, a planthopper associated with reeds, which had no previous records in Hertfordshire.

At Aldbury Nowers, near Tring, the leafhopper Zygina hyperici was recorded for the first time in the county since 1916.

Arboridia parvula, a leafhopper associated with Common Rockrose, was also recorded for the first time in Hertfordshire since 1976. The survey also uncovered Agyneta mollis, a tiny nationally rare money spider.

Jersey Tiger moths, once more strongly associated with the Channel Islands, have increasingly been recorded further north, while Hummingbird Hawk-moths are also being seen regularly in Hertfordshire.

Townsend said: "These discoveries help us understand which species are present, where they are found and how they are responding to changes in their environment.

"That knowledge is essential for informing the management of our nature reserves effectively and giving wildlife the opportunity to thrive."

Follow Beds, Herts and Bucks news on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , Instagram , external and X , external .
body.zh: 野生动物信托基金表示，今年夏天，多年来首次在自然保护区发现了一些物种。 赫茨和米德尔塞克斯野生动物信托基金会的志愿者在韦尔附近记录了一只大白鹭，在希钦附近的赫克斯顿粉笔坑记录了 300 多只查克希尔蓝蝴蝶，他们还在那里发现了 25 年来的首次萤火虫。 该信托基金表示，部分原因是异常炎热的天气，但也是该县加强调查和监测的结果。 高级保护区官员丹·汤森德（Dan Townsend）说：“今年夏天，我们取得了一些非凡的记录，从赫特福德郡几十年来没有记录的物种到个别保护区的新发现。” 这家总部位于圣奥尔本斯的信托基金管理着赫特福德郡和米德尔塞克斯郡的 40 多个自然保护区，占地近 810 公顷（2,000 英亩）。 报告称，蝗虫在炎热的夏季繁衍生息，而蝴蝶则能够更快地完成生命周期并大量涌现。 其储量为 2015 年设立的外部赫茨无脊椎动物项目的多项重大发现奠定了基础。 6月底，该项目访问了Potters Bar附近的Fir & Pond Woods，记录了一种与芦苇有关的飞虱Euides basilinea，该种飞虱在赫特福德郡以前没有记录。 在特林附近的奥尔德伯里诺尔斯 (Aldbury Nowers)，自 1916 年以来首次在该县记录到叶蝉 Zygina hyperici。 自 1976 年以来，赫特福德郡首次记录到与常见岩玫瑰相关的叶蝉 Arboridia parvula。调查还发现了 Agyneta mollis，一种全国罕见的小型金钱蜘蛛。 泽西虎蛾再次与海峡群岛密切相关，越来越多地在更北的地方出现，而蜂鸟鹰蛾也经常出现在赫特福德郡。 汤森德说：“这些发现帮助我们了解存在哪些物种、在哪里发现它们以及它们如何应对环境的变化。 “这些知识对于有效地管理我们的自然保护区并为野生动物提供繁衍生息的机会至关重要。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、Instagram、external 和 X, external 上关注 Beds、Herts 和 Bucks 的新闻。

title.en: Why it matters that President Trump just dialed into a NASA news conference
title.zh: 为什么特朗普总统刚刚拨通美国宇航局新闻发布会很重要

summary.en: With just one more major mission upcoming, NASA's science programs need a boost.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: As is standard procedure for major NASA missions, the US space agency held a post-launch news conference on Sunday morning at Kennedy Space Center in Florida to provide information about how the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was faring during its initial maneuvers. What was not standard, however, is what happened in the middle of the news conference. A little less than half an hour in, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman looked down at his mobile phone, and then stood up and walked away from the dais where he had been seated behind a table along with other NASA officials. He briefly left the room. Isaacman returned about a minute later, phone in hand, apologizing for interrupting NASA's chief of science, Nicky Fox, as she was speaking about the mission. "The President of the United States of America would like to address and congratulate everyone on this mission," Isaacman said, returning to his seat. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 按照美国宇航局重大任务的标准程序，美国航天局周日上午在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心举行了发射后新闻发布会，提供有关南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜在初始演习期间运行情况的信息。然而，不正常的是新闻发布会中间发生的事情。不到半小时后，美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼低头看了看手机，然后站起来，离开了讲台，他和其他美国宇航局官员坐在桌子后面。他短暂地离开了房间。大约一分钟后，艾萨克曼手里拿着电话回来了，他为打断美国宇航局科学主管尼基·福克斯谈论这次任务而道歉。 “美利坚合众国总统谨向执行此任务的所有人致辞并表示祝贺，”艾萨克曼回到座位上说道。阅读全文 评论
